49751-three-minute-stories.title: Books For Young People
49751-three-minute-stories.creator: Unknown
49751-three-minute-stories.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Many of these stories and rhymes appeared originally in the _Ladies’ Home Journal_, and were signed either with my initials, or with names of characters in my books. Others were adapted by me from the Indian “Hitopadesa,” or “Book of Good Counsel,” and from two anonymous story-books of a bygone generation, long out of print.

arxiv-2104-08290.title: Radio Line Properties of Axion Dark Matter Conversion in Neutron Stars
arxiv-2104-08290.creator: R. A. Battye, B. Garbrecht, J. I. McDonald, S. Srinivasan
arxiv-2104-08290.description: Abstract Axions are well-motivated candidates for dark matter. Recently, much interest has focused on the detection of photons produced by the resonant conversion of axion dark matter in neutron star magnetospheres. Various groups have begun to obtain radio data to search for the signal, however, more work is needed to obtain a robust theory prediction for the corresponding radio lines.

arxiv-2105-13732.title: SoK: Achieving State Machine Replication in Blockchains based on Repeated Consensus DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 CCS: Theory of computation Distributed algorithms
arxiv-2105-13732.creator: Silvia Bonomi, Antonella Del Pozzo, Álvaro García-Pérez, Sara Tucci-Piergiovanni
arxiv-2105-13732.description: Abstract . This paper revisits the ubiquitous problem of achieving state machine replication in blockchains based on repeated consensus, like Tendermint. To achieve state machine replication in blockchains built on top of consensus, one needs to guarantee fairness of user transactions.

arxiv-2108-09103.title: Mobility-Aware Cluster Federated Learning in Hierarchical Wireless Networks
arxiv-2108-09103.creator: Chenyuan Feng, Howard H. Yang, Deshun Hu, Zhiwei Zhao, Tony Q. S. Quek, Geyong Min
arxiv-2108-09103.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chenyuan Feng, Howard H. Yang, Deshun Hu, Zhiwei Zhao, Tony Q. S. Quek, Geyong Min. Implementing federated learning (FL) algorithms in wireless networks has garnered a wide range of attention. However, few works have considered the impact of user mobility on the learning performance.

arxiv-2309-15963.title: An Uncertainty-Aware Pseudo-Label Selection Framework using Regularized Conformal Prediction
arxiv-2309-15963.creator: Matin Moezzi
arxiv-2309-15963.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matin Moezzi. Consistency regularization based methods are prevalent semi-supervised learning (SSL) algorithms due to their exceptional performance. However, they mainly depend on domain-specific data augmentations, which are not usable in domains where data augmentations are less practicable. On the other hand, Pseudo-labeling (PL) is a general and domain-agnostic SSL approach that, unlike consistency regularization based methods, does not rely on the domain. PL underperforms due to the erroneous high confidence predictions from poorly calibrated models.

arxiv-2311-15865.title: A precise symbolic emulator of the linear matter power spectrum
arxiv-2311-15865.creator: Deaglan J. Bartlett, Lukas Kammerer, Gabriel Kronberger, Harry Desmond, Pedro G. Ferreira, Benjamin D. Wandelt, Bogdan Burlacu, David Alonso, Matteo Zennaro
arxiv-2311-15865.description: Abstract Context. Computing the matter power spectrum, P ⁡ ( k ) P(k) , as a function of cosmological parameters can be prohibitively slow in cosmological analyses, hence emulating this calculation is desirable. Previous analytic approximations are insufficiently accurate for modern applications, so black-box, uninterpretable emulators are often used. Aims.

arxiv-2401-12617.title: The Joint Effect of Task Similarity and Overparameterization on Catastrophic Forgetting — An Analytical Model
arxiv-2401-12617.creator: Daniel Goldfarb, Itay Evron, Nir Weinberger, Daniel Soudry, Paul Hand
arxiv-2401-12617.description: Abstract In continual learning, catastrophic forgetting is affected by multiple aspects of the tasks. Previous works have analyzed separately how forgetting is affected by either task similarity or overparameterization. In contrast, our paper examines how task similarity and overparameterization jointly affect forgetting in an analyzable model.

arxiv-2404-14571.title: A Survey of Decomposition-Based Evolutionary Multi-Objective Optimization: Part I —Past and Future
arxiv-2404-14571.creator: Ke Li
arxiv-2404-14571.description: Abstract Abstract: Decomposition has been the mainstream approach in classic mathematical programming for multi-objective optimization and multi-criterion decision-making. However, it was not properly studied in the context of evolutionary multi-objective optimization (EMO) until the development of multi-objective evolutionary algorithm based on decomposition (MOEA/D).

arxiv-2404-17220.title: Infinite dimensional Slow Manifolds for a Linear Fast-Reaction System Thanks: The first author was supported in part by DFG grant 456754695 and a Lichtenberg professorship via the VolkswagenStiftung. The third author was supported by DFG grant 456754695.
arxiv-2404-17220.creator: Christian Kuehn, Pascal Lehner, Jan-Eric Sulzbach
arxiv-2404-17220.description: Abstract . The aim of this expository paper is twofold. We start with a concise overview of the theory of invariant slow manifolds for fast-slow dynamical systems starting with the work by Tikhonov and Fenichel to the most recent works on infinite-dimensional fast-slow systems.

arxiv-2407-11276.title: A practical approach to calculating magnetic Johnson noise for precision measurements
arxiv-2407-11276.creator: N. S. Phan, S. M. Clayton, Y. J. Kim, T. M. Ito
arxiv-2407-11276.description: Abstract Magnetic Johnson noise is an important consideration for many applications involving precision magnetometry, and its significance will only increase in the future with improvements in measurement sensitivity. The fluctuation-dissipation theorem can be utilized to derive analytic expressions for magnetic Johnson noise in certain situations.

arxiv-2408-02169.title: Correlation of 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta decay nuclear matrix elements with nucleon-nucleon phase shifts
arxiv-2408-02169.creator: A. Belley, J. Pitcher, T. Miyagi, S. R. Stroberg, J. D. Holt
arxiv-2408-02169.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. Belley, J. Pitcher, T. Miyagi, S. R. Stroberg, J. D. Holt. We present an ab initio study of the correlation between nuclear matrix elements of 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta decay and nucleon-nucleon scattering phase shifts in the S 0 1 {}^{1}S_{0} channel. Starting from thirty-four statistically weighted interactions derived from chiral effective field theory, we apply the valence-space in-medium similarity renormalization group to calculate nuclear matrix elements in four key experimental isotopes.

arxiv-2601-19535.title: LURE-RAG: Lightweight Utility-driven Reranking for Efficient RAG
arxiv-2601-19535.creator: Manish Chandra, Debasis Ganguly, Iadh Ounis
arxiv-2601-19535.description: Abstract Most conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines rely on relevance-based retrieval, which often misaligns with utility – that is, whether the retrieved passages actually improve the quality of the generated text specific to a downstream task such as question answering or query-based summarization.

arxiv-2602-19374.title: High-order long-time asymptotics for small solutions to the one-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2602-19374.creator: Jacek Jendrej, Tony Salvi
arxiv-2602-19374.description: Abstract Abstract We investigate the global well-posedness and modified scattering for the one-dimensional Schrödinger equation with gauge-invariant polynomial nonlinearity. For small localized initial data of finite energy in a low-regularity class, we establish global existence of solution together with persistence of the localization of the associated profile.

pmc-10506236.creator: Hongchuan Niu, Kai Li, Xiaoning Liang, Desheng Kong, Zongze Li, Fengqiao Sun, Xianzeng Liu, Zongsheng Xu, Xuejiao Wei, Shuang Lan, Changyu Lu
pmc-10506236.description: BackgroundTo describe and report the efficacy and safety of MR-guided laser interstitial thermal therapy (MRgLITT) in the treatment of drug-resistant epilepsy.MethodsA retrospective review of all MRgLITT procedures in our hospital was performed. All procedures were performed using a surgical laser ablation system. Demographic and outcome data were compiled and analyzed.

pmc-11359525.title: In Vitro Antiprotozoal Activity of Schinus molle Extract, Partitions, and Fractions against Trypanosoma cruzi
pmc-11359525.creator: Nancy E Rodríguez-Garza, Ramiro Quintanilla-Licea, Ricardo Gomez-Flores, Lucio Galaviz-Silva, Zinnia J Molina-Garza
pmc-11359525.description: Chagas disease, caused by the protozoan Trypanosoma cruzi, represents an important and worldwide public health issue, particularly in Latin America. Limitations of conventional treatment with benznidazole and nifurtimox underscore the urgent need for new therapeutic strategies for this disease. Schinus molle, a tree used in traditional medicine for various ailments, has demonstrated promising antiparasitic activity. The in vitro anti-T.

pmc-11360213.title: Closed Loop Ultrafiltration Feedback Control in Hemodialysis: A Narrative Review
pmc-11360213.creator: Zijun Dong, Lemuel Rivera Fuentes, Sharon Rao, Peter Kotanko
pmc-11360213.description: While life-sustaining, hemodialysis is a non-physiological treatment modality that exerts stress on the patient, primarily due to fluid shifts during ultrafiltration. Automated feedback control systems, integrated with sensors that continuously monitor bio-signals such as blood volume, can adjust hemodialysis treatment parameters, e.g., ultrafiltration rate, in real-time.

pmc-11427293.title: Enhanced antioxidant phytochemicals and catalase activity of celery by-products by a combined strategy of selenium and PGPB under restricted N supply
pmc-11427293.creator: Jacinta Collado-González, María Carmen Piñero, Ginés Otálora, Josefa López-Marín, Francisco M. del Amor
pmc-11427293.description: IntroductionThe reduction of N supplied combined with the use of biostimulants can be an efficient strategy that allows sustainable agriculture to achieve better economic, nutritional and environmental goals without reducing production. Moreover, the industrial processing of celery generates large amounts of waste.

pmc-11516805.title: Quality indicators of long-term care for older people in OECD countries; a rapid scoping review
pmc-11516805.creator: A Ordonez Cruickshank, A Zanuzdana, V Marujo, K Heldt, J Fuchs, B Gaertner, M Hasseler, T Eckmanns, C Scheidt-Nave
pmc-11516805.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic has exposed the vulnerability of older people living in long-term care facilities (LTCF), highlighting the urgent need for research on the quality of care for this group of the population. There is no universal definition for quality of care in LTCF, and yet, multiple tools and indicators have been developed to measure it.

pmc-12535540.title: Heterologous expression and optimization of the antimicrobial peptide acidocin 4356 in Komagataella phaffii to target Pseudomonas aeruginosa
pmc-12535540.creator: Ali Akbari, Mahbubeh Talaee, Mohammad Mir-Derikvand, Navid Dad, Sima Modiri, Fatemeh Saadati, Negin Noorbakhsh, Hossein Shahbani Zahiri, Hojatollah Vali, Kambiz Akbari Noghabi
pmc-12535540.description: Multidrug-resistant (MDR) pathogens, particularly Pseudomonas aeruginosa, pose a serious global health threat due to their increasing prevalence and limited therapeutic options. Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) offer promising alternatives to traditional antibiotics, yet their large-scale application remains constrained by high production costs and technical challenges.

pmc-12650980.title: Immune Age, Cardiovascular Disease, and Anti-Viral Immunity
pmc-12650980.creator: Kevin-Phu C Le, Fahad Shuja, Jorg J Goronzy, Cornelia M Weyand, Alexander E Kalyuzhny
pmc-12650980.description: Cardiovascular morbidity and mortality rise precipitously during the 6th–9th decades of life, identifying aging as a critical risk factor. Simultaneously, older individuals are susceptible to severe viral infection, raising the question whether shared mechanisms exist that predispose to both cardiovascular disease (CVD) and failing anti-viral immunity.

pmc-13660766.title: AKT Phosphorylation of FOXK2 at Ser398 Impacts Breast Cancer Cell Growth and Viability
pmc-13660766.creator: L T Carneiro, J M R C Nunes, G De Gregoriis, B S Mendonça, W M Araújo, R C Maia, E W F Lam, R S Carvalho, M A Carvalho, A D Sharrocks, G Nestal de Moraes
pmc-13660766.description: FOXK2 is a transcription factor known to mediate drug sensitivity in breast cancer. However, poor prognosis patients and drug‐resistant cells exhibit constitutively elevated levels of FOXK2 protein, which appears functionally inactive. Although emerging evidence suggests that FOXK2 is regulated by post‐translational modifications, the underlying mechanisms in breast cancer remain poorly understood.

pmc-13681468.title: Efficacy and safety of temporary selective portal vein embolization before major hepatectomy (EMBORES): a phase 2 trial
pmc-13681468.creator: Hadrien Tranchart, Sophie Maitre, Edouard Girard, Julien Ghelfi, Maximiliano Gelli, Lambros Tselikas, Maxime Barat, David Fuks, Anthony Sarran, Stéphane Benoist, Olivier Meyrignac, Ailton Sepulveda, Maxime Ronot, Maryne Pou, Mircea Chirica, Ibrahim Dagher, Christian Sengel, Christian Sengel, Antoine
pmc-13681468.description: SummaryBackgroundPortal vein embolization (PVE) is routinely used before major hepatectomy to induce hypertrophy of the future liver remnant (FLR) and reduce post-hepatectomy liver failure. Conventional PVE relies on permanent embolic agents, resulting in irreversible portal occlusion, which may be associated with complications and may limit subsequent therapeutic options in patients who do not ultimately undergo resection.
